Air India's Maharaja Club Partners with Golf Tour

Air India's Maharaja Club has been named the official travel partner of the DP World Professional Golf Tour of India. The partnership aims to boost Indian golf, with cricketer Kapil Dev reportedly hailing the tie-up.
